intro.text: A fruit of Roshar, made into a red jam. Palates of Personality says those who like the jam are spontaneous and impulsive and love the outdoors.

description.text: Its flesh is clear. Fermented, it makes a sweet wine that stays clear if the rinds are removed with care.

items.text: Kabsal brought Shallan simberry jam while she studied at the Palanaeum in Kharbranth. It was supposedly a gift for Jasnah, but he knew Shallan loved jam.
When Shallan confronted Ialai Sadeas, Ialai offered her a simberry wine of Alethi vintage from her collection, one Shallan had never tasted.
